verses.text: Masanil juntzanh tik ix wil wal yet' in sat, ix wab' wal yet' in chikin.
Ha tas eyojtak a ex tik, wojtakpaxi, mantok yelxo wal emnakil waj t'ayex.
Palta tzin nib'ej tzin lolon yet' Dios Syal Yuj Smasanil. Tzin nib'ej tzin telaj in b'a yet'ok.
Ha ex tik, yuj eyesalwumal tze k'ub'anel tas yel. Lajan ex yet' heb' anhtum malaj wach' yochi.
Komonok numan tzex aji, yik icha chi' scheklaji to jelan ex.
Maklejek eyab' tas ol wala', ol wal tas nab'il wuuj.
¿Am he naani to ol ex kolwaj t'a Dios yuj eyesalwumal chi'? ¿Am he naani to ay tas ol yik' t'a he ak'oj musansatil chi'?
Tze nib'ej tzeyak'och he b'a yet' Dios, tze kolan he naani.
Palta q'uinalok tzex ch'olb'itaj yuj Dios chi', ¿tas tzex aj he naani? ¿Tzam yal eyak'an musansatil, icha tzeyutej junok anima?
Tato tze komon ak'ejoch he b'a yet' Dios he naani, ol ex stumej sik'lab'il.
Ha wal smay ol ik'an he xiwi, mato syal he tek'b'an he b'a t'a yichanh he naani.
Ha juntzanh peka' k'ayb'ub'al tzeyala', malaj yelk'ochi, lajan icha junok muro nab'a lu'um skak'och yipok ko k'ool.
Haxo tiknaik, tz'inek xe chi to ol in lolonok, taxonhej skot t'a wib'anh yuj tas ol wal tik.
Wach'chom skotxonhej t'a wib'anh, palta ol walnhej.
Wach'chom yuj chi' tzin smilcham Dios, palta ol wak'nhejoch yipok in k'ool. Ol in kolnhej in b'a t'a yichanh.
Talaj hata' ay in kolnab'il, yujto a junok mach chuk max stek'b'ej sb'a yoch t'a yichanh Dios.
Maklejek wal eyab' tas ol aj walani.
Toxo ix in na' tas ol wutej in kolan in b'a, wojtak to wach' ol in elk'ochok.
Tato ay mach sch'oxaneli to ay in mul, syal woch waan walani masanto tzin chami.
Ach in Diosal, chab'nhej wal tas tzin k'an t'ayach, icha chi' syal in k'och t'a ichanh.
Aktejxo ak'anoch in yaelal tik, manhxo in a xib'tej yet' tas ay smay.
Awtej in, ol in tak'wok t'ayach, ma jun, tzin b'ab'laj loloni, tzach tak'wi t'ayin.
Al t'ayin, ¿b'ajtil ix och in mul, ma in paltail? ¿B'ajtil ay b'aj ix in ek' t'a yib'anh chi'?
¿Tas yuj tza k'ub'ejel a b'a t'ayin? ¿Tas yuj icha junok ajk'ol tzin utej?
Lajan in icha junok xil te' tz'ik'jib'at yuj ik', ma icha anh takinh ak. ¿Tas yuj tzak' owal wet'ok, tza nib'ej tzin a sateli?
Te ya tzal t'ayin swab'i. Tza k'anb'an t'ayin tastak in mul yiktax in kelemal.
Ichato ix ak'och k'een cadena t'a wok, k'elan achnhej ochi b'aj tz'em wok.
Yuj chi' wanxo in k'ab'at icha junok tas sk'ai, ma icha junok pichul ijtakxo.
